sentence: A resource contract can act as a hidden research incentive.

sentence: When an autonomous researcher is scored under a fixed wall-clock budget, an edit that makes training faster is rewarded twice, once for its effect on the model and again because the faster candidate sees more data before it is evaluated, so the contract itself can shape what looks like a discovery.
support: Fixed-time stopping rule and per-attempt token counts

sentence: We study this in AutoPareto, an autonomous Transformer researcher that edits its own training source under measured quality, cached-decode throughput, and inference-memory objectives on a single GPU, retaining every hypothesis, patch, and parent link it produced.
support: Historical program, hardware manifests, and three protected objectives

sentence: To separate discovery from evidence we froze its archived recipes and retrained them on unseen seeds at exactly matched token exposure, and we registered a prospective fixed-time versus fixed-token comparison, so far an exploratory \TimeN{}-attempt prefix per arm.
support: Twenty-one matched-exposure runs; registered Pair A protocol

sentence: The discovery-stage quality advantage does not survive matched exposure.
support: Discovery validation ranking and matched-exposure held-out panel

sentence: The deployment result does: the verified recipe retains \DecodeRatio$\times$ cached-decode throughput with \ParameterReduction\% fewer parameters and \MemoryReduction\% less allocated inference memory.
support: Three-seed matched-exposure inference and memory repetitions

sentence: Trajectories, contracts, seeds, source hashes, and raw measurements are preserved, so every reported number can be re-derived without rerunning training.
Resource contracts should be treated as part of the scientific specification of autonomous ML research.
The autonomous search produced a frozen recipe, AP292, whose efficiency gains survive matched-exposure verification while its discovery-stage quality advantage does not.

Across seeds 3 to 5, after exactly 201,326,592 counted training tokens, AP292 reaches \APSpeed{} cached-decode tokens/s against \ARSpeed{} for the selected AutoResearch recipe (\DecodeRatio$\times$), with \APParams{}M against \ARParams{}M parameters (\ParameterReduction\% fewer), \APMemory{} against \ARMemory{} MiB peak allocated inference memory (\MemoryReduction\% less), and \APKV{} against \ARKV{} MiB measured incremental KV-cache memory (\KVReduction\% less), at a held-out BPB cost of \BPBCost{} (\APBPB{} against \ARBPB{}).
support: Matched-exposure panel; differences and ratios of three-seed means

sentence: The verified result is an agent-discovered quality-efficiency frontier point under this A40 workload, not an exposure-controlled quality improvement. The qualifying autonomous contribution is the source-edit trajectory that produced the recipe; matched-exposure retraining establishes what survives.
support: Campaign programs, recorded lineage, and the complete outcome panel
